name: Blockallisto token motion spec

tokenDock.description: Purchase success: the floating corner tile slides into the open slot of the block and settles from Indigo 400 to solid Indigo.
tokenDock.coordinateSpace: 240-unit viewBox of the SVG logo sources
tokenDock.path: single straight 45-degree slide; no curve or waypoint
notes: The dashed slot is centered exactly on the slide vector, so the tile lands flush on the dashed outline.
Keep the tile above the block outline during the slide so it reads as arriving from outside.
durationMs 700 is the recommended default for the success moment; micro-transitions elsewhere stay at 200ms.

loadingPulse.description: While the platform refreshes live data from the Stellar network, the open (dashed) token pulses.

rules: tokenDock: replace the slide with a 200ms opacity fade into the slot
loadingPulse: disabled; the dashed token rests at 100% opacity
color and state changes keep the 200ms transition

status: Design specification for the production platform - not implemented anywhere. The current testnet prototype records contribution confirmations only; there are no real purchases, so tokenDock/loadingPulse describe future product behavior.
